title: Asymptotic Properties of the Maximum Likelihood Estimator for Markov-Switching Observation-Driven Models
abstract: arXiv:2412.19555v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A Markov-switching observation-driven model is a stochastic process $((S_t,Y_t))_{t \in \mathbb{Z}}$ where $(S_t)_{t \in \mathbb{Z}}$ is an unobserved Markov chain with finite state space and $(Y_t)_{t \in \mathbb{Z}}$ is an observed stochastic process such that the conditional distribution of $Y_t$ given $(Y_\tau)_{\tau \leq t-1}$ and $(S_\tau)_{\tau \leq t}$ depends only on $(Y_\tau)_{\tau \leq t-1}$, through time-varying parameters, and $S_t$. In this paper, we prove consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator for such a model. As a special case, we also give conditions under which the maximum likelihood estimator for the widely applied Markov-switching generalised autoregressive conditional heteroscedasticity model introduced by Haas, Mittnik, and Paolella (2004b) is consistent and asymptotically normal.

translated_title: 马尔可夫切换观测驱动模型极大似然估计量的渐近性质
translated_abstract: 马尔可夫切换观测驱动模型是一个随机过程 $((S_t,Y_t))_{t \in \mathbb{Z}}$，其中 $(S_t)_{t \in \mathbb{Z}}$ 是一个具有有限状态空间的不可观测马尔可夫链，$(Y_t)_{t \in \mathbb{Z}}$ 是一个可观测的随机过程，使得在给定 $(Y_\tau)_{\tau \leq t-1}$ 和 $(S_\tau)_{\tau \leq t}$ 的条件下，$Y_t$ 的条件分布仅通过时变参数依赖于 $(Y_\tau)_{\tau \leq t-1}$ 以及 $S_t$。本文证明了此类模型极大似然估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。作为一个特例，我们还给出了 Haas、Mittnik 和 Paolella（2004b）提出的被广泛应用的马尔可夫切换广义自回归条件异方差（MS-GARCH）模型的极大似然估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性的条件。
tldr: 本文证明了马尔可夫切换观测驱动模型极大似然估计量的一致性与渐近正态性，并作为特例给出了广泛应用的马尔可夫切换GARCH模型极大似然估计量满足这些性质的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper proves consistency and asymptotic normality of the maximum likelihood estimator for Markov-switching observation-driven models, including as a special case the widely applied Markov-switching GARCH model.
